title: dot ai cost report v1 (what agent sessions cost)
description: Printed by `dot ai cost show --json` (dot-ai-tui cost). Read from the transcripts Claude Code and Codex keep, the gateway's usage log and the run log; Claude sessions also count what Claude Code's own cost figure reports beyond their transcripts. Costs are at API list prices: on a subscription, what the tokens would cost, not a bill. Metadata only: never a prompt or an answer.

key.description: The group: an agent, host, day (YYYY-MM-DD), model, or agent/session

input_tokens.description: All prompt tokens: uncached input, cache writes and cache reads

unpriced_tokens.description: Tokens on models with no known price, left out of cost_usd

days.description: The window: today and the days before it

session.description: With --session: the session reported, by model
